subject: Okta purchase order split + evidence collection
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Team —

Quick summary: Okta returned the updated SOW and commercial (attached). Our finance team flagged that the full FY commitment would blow the current quarter’s capital plan. They're open to a split PO across Q3/Q4 (70% now, 30% in Q4) if Okta can accept staggered billing and keep pricing/discounting intact. I want to pursue that to avoid delaying the device-posture rollout.

Two asks:
1) Neha/Monica — can you confirm whether a 70/30 PO split is workable from your side (tax, revenue recognition, and supplier terms)? If we need a contract amendment rather than two POs, note that.
2) Marissa — please engage Okta AM for explicit acceptance of split billing + confirmation their renewal pricing will be honored for the whole term. Also ask for the up-to-date compliance artifacts we need for procurement (SOC 2, device posture assessment guidance).

I’d like replies by EOD tomorrow so we can propose a timeline to Okta next week.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Infrastructure Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@okta.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Okta Contracts <contracts@okta.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the note and the clear ask. We can accommodate a 70/30 PO split (billing split and scheduled invoices) under two linked POs against the same SOW, provided the term and effective date are identical and both POs reference the master agreement. Okta will honor the commercial terms in the current quote if both POs are submitted within 30 days.

Attachments: we’re sending the SOC 2 Type II (2026) and a device-posture implementation checklist. I attached an updated SOW (v3) that reflects the device-posture add-on and the seat counts you provided.

For the discount: the 12% volume discount you currently have is predicated on the committed seat tier. Splitting POs will not affect price tiers as long as the combined committed seats are the same and the POs reference the same commitment ID. If finance needs consolidated invoicing we can do a summarized invoice in Q4.

I’ll get contracts on a DocuSign envelope after you confirm the PO approach.

Best,
Samir
Enterprise Account Executive — Okta
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@okta.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Samir — appreciated. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:
- Procurement is okay with two POs if they are linked and reference the same deal id.
- Finance needs the split reflected in a single internal workbook (I’ll attach the PO_Redwood_70-30.xlsx) and an approval memo that explains the rationale (attached as Redwood_Approval_Memo.pdf).
- Security needs the SOC2 and the device posture checklist to close our standard vendor onboarding.

Action: Samir, please send the DocuSign for the SOW and indicate the commitment ID that both POs should reference. Once we have that, Procurement can issue PO-1 (70%) now and PO-2 (30%) dated for 2027-10-01.

Two clarifying questions:
1) If we issue PO-2 with a future date, can Okta invoice when PO-2 becomes active, or do you prefer to raise invoices pro rata?
2) Any service activation dependencies tied to PO-2 that would block rollout of device posture if the Q4 PO is delayed?

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Partnerships
From: Okta Contracts <contracts@okta.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@okta.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T14:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Marissa —

We confirm:
- Two POs are acceptable. Each PO should cite the Deal ID (D-47291) and the same effective date.
- Okta will invoice PO-1 upon execution and PO-2 on or after the dated start (2027-10-01). If PO-2 is delayed beyond 30 days from the dated start, billing will be adjusted unless you notify us.
- No technical gating is tied to PO-2 for the core device-posture rollout — activation of device agents and policy enforcement can start with PO-1. Some advanced integrations (tenant split and telemetry retention changes) that are scoped in SOW v3 will require the PO-2 items to be active for full parity.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-OKTA-47291 (envelope sent to marissa_cole@redwood.com)

Regards,
Okta Contracts Team
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Markus/Marissa —

Checked with Finance and Tax: two POs are fine. A couple of compliance notes:
- Please ensure we attach SOC 2 Type II (we have it from Okta’s link) to the supplier file.
- For revenue recognition our accounting team will want the PO-2 to include the exact deliverable schedule or a clear rental/term reference to avoid treating the Q4 portion as a separate contract. If Okta can include a clause in the SOW that both POs correspond to a single commitment, that will be ideal.

I’ve routed the PO workbook to CFO for quick sign-off; expect formal PO numbers by 8/3 EOD if DocuSign goes through today.

Neha
Head of Finance Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@okta.com>, Okta Contracts <contracts@okta.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Okta purchase order split + ask list

Samir / Contracts team —

Thanks — DocuSign executed and Finance issued PO-1: PO-RED-2027-0917 for 70% (attached to procurement file). PO-2 will be dated 2027-10-01 and enumerated once CFO signs the Q4 schedule. We’ll upload SOC 2 and the signed SOW to the vendor portal today.

Two quick operational items for Okta:
- Please confirm the commitment ID to reference on both POs and the consolidated invoice approach for Q4.
- Security asks that Okta add a brief implementation note in SOW v3 about which features in the device-posture bundle are active immediately and which require the Q4 items. That will help us stage rollout without service interruption.

If you can confirm by tomorrow, Procurement will close the file.

Appreciate the flexibility on split billing —
Markus
